correctness.rationale: The proof reduces X-raying to strict sign separation of vertex normal cones. Exact coordinate arguments produce upper bounds 4,4,3,3,3. The cube lower bound follows because one direction covers at most one antipodal vertex pair; the tetrahedral lower bound follows from the published weakly-neighbourly-antipodal proposition after an explicit antipodality witness; the other three meet the universal dimension-three lower bound. The bundled exact Q(sqrt(5)) checker reconstructs all dodecahedral and icosahedral facets, edges, and sign certificates.

value.rationale: The five Platonic solids form a canonical complete class. Exact classification of a classical convex-geometric invariant on all five is mathematically natural and exposes a structural 4,4,3,3,3 split rather than a routine one-object increment.
